label: Early-sequence reset: inputs z/k/3/m/o/l at steps 2-3, and <DEL> for short sequences (L<=4)
explanation: Fires only early in the sequence (absolute steps 2-5, never at t=0-1 or after t=6) and never in the copy phase. Two components, both tied to early absolute position: (1) original-phase inputs at t=2-3 (also weaker at t=4-5), strongly preferring tokens z, k, 3 (rate ~17-19%), then m, o, l, with other tokens firing weakly; (2) the <DEL> step when it arrives early, i.e. L=3 (~100% precision) or L=4 (~72%), and rarely for L=5. The largest activations are <DEL> at t=3 for L=3 sequences (top examples are all 3-token sequences); magnitude falls with t. Mostly first occurrences of a token (in_first=1 holds 94% of mass), but requiring no earlier high-preference token hurts recall. Missed mass is weak activations on other tokens at t=2-4. Dev F1 0.74, mass recall 0.84.
